items.text: No Zay Flowers again at today’s (Thursday) practice. Hamstring aggravated in Week 1; day-to-day previously, DNP Wednesday too.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practice Wednesday and Thursday
items.implication: Uncertain for Week 2 vs Saints; thin WR room with Lane on IR

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins injured his hamstring at Wednesday’s practice; doctors don’t believe it’s serious, but his status for Sunday vs. Bengals is in jeopardy. Listed limited Wednesday; history of missing 5 games on hammy in 2024.
items.why: Hamstring strain (Grade 1 per later reports); MRI/tests; not serious but availability uncertain
items.implication: Major target share loss if out; monitor Friday practice
items.opportunity: Routes last week: Collins 37/42 dropbacks; Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27 next

items.text: Kenneth Walker: not saying likely but #1 RB overall in fantasy is within range of outcomes. Week 1 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career). Massive season if healthy.
items.why: Elite target share + rushing volume in new offense

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 2 role; potential snap loss

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, didn’t practice Wednesday but got mental reps and expects to play Sunday. Status worth watching.
Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury; no plans to place on IR.
items.implication: Backup QB starts; no IR means quicker potential return

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery to quicken recovery; out four games.
items.implication: Out minimum 4 games; Flowers already banged up

items.text: A.J. Brown hit IR (high-ankle sprain, ~4-6 weeks); ETR flags Romeo Doubs and DeMario Douglas as beneficiaries.
items.implication: NE WR targets open; Doubs upgrade

items.text: De’Zhaun Stribling to IR (ankle); ETR waiver flags Deebo Samuel as primary beneficiary along with Demarcus Robinson. Shanahan expects ~10 weeks.
items.implication: Deebo top waiver target for SF targets/snaps

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opps, 19 routes/33 dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominant early-down and receiving role as expected in KC
items.implication: Elite RB1 weekly floor/ceiling if healthy

items.text: First run of Week 2 fantasy point projections LIVE for every player/game. Purdy 2.5 pts clear in one noted spot.
items.implication: Use for start/sit and DFS baselines

items.text: Ashton Jeanty Utilization Score of 99 in first game under Kubiak (only Bijan higher). May have overreacted to injury scare.
Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full participant in Wednesday practice; indication he could return Sunday.
49ers TE Jake Tonges out for the season after surgery for torn MCL.
